description: Defines structures and functions for writing and iterating over reftable blocks, including block writer initialization, adding records, finishing blocks, and iterating through block records.

classes.name: block_writer
classes.description: Structure for writing reftable blocks, managing compression, restarts, and entries.

classes.name: block_iter
classes.description: Iterator for traversing records within a single reftable block.

methods.name: block_writer_init
methods.description: Initializes a block_writer for writing a specified number of entries.

methods.name: block_writer_type
methods.description: Returns the type of the block (e.g., 'r' for ref records).

methods.name: block_writer_add
methods.description: Attempts to append a record to the block.

methods.name: block_writer_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the block, compresses if needed, and prepares it for writing.

methods.name: block_writer_release
methods.description: Releases internal resources of the block_writer.

methods.name: block_iter_init
methods.description: Initializes a block iterator for a specific block.

methods.name: block_iter_seek_start
methods.description: Positions the iterator at the first record in the block.

methods.name: block_iter_seek_key
methods.description: Positions the iterator at a specific key, if present.

methods.name: block_iter_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next record.

methods.name: block_iter_reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to its initial state.

methods.name: block_iter_close
methods.description: Deallocates resources associated with the iterator.

methods.name: header_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file header based on version.

methods.name: footer_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the file footer based on version.
